title: Blood on pillow after 1988 camping trip

tellings.quote: his pillow. You did mention after the camping trip in 1988 you waking up with blood on your pillow,

plain: After a camping trip in 1988, a former nuclear missile guard named Richard Barth woke up to find blood on his pillow. Michels raises it with Barth himself, repeating what Barth had told him earlier, in an episode about Barth's account of being taken by aliens. The point is that the blood could be a physical trace of an abduction.
